title: Autrey as Fats's right-hand man; Fats's wife's remark
summary: Autrey was closest to Fats; they drank and partied together, and Fats's wife once said she wished she knew her husband as well.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Were you closer to him than the other guys in the band?

I think so. I've been accused of that. I've been accused of being his right-hand man. We hung out together. We drank together. We went on parties together. And we did -- I don't know. I don't know. I don't know if -- oh, I remember his wife saying a couple of times, I wish I knew my husband as well as you do.
Did you have an answer to that?
No, I don't have -- I say well, you know, what am I going to say?
Well, of course you were on the road with him all the time. Did she get to see him very much? Did he get home at all?

Yeah, when we -- well, we -- we'd stay out long as the thing lasted, the one-nighters, the tour, whatever it was, lasted, and we'd come home. You know. And somebody said something one day about money. She said give my husband $2.00. He'll find a woman.
